title: First-principles study of solvation effects on propylene carbonate reduction on defective hard carbon, for advanced sodium-ion battery anodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5427-5436
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07677C, Paper

Jin-Song Kim, Myong-Jin Won, Won Pak, Kum-Hui Pak, Chol Ryu, Chol-Jun Yu
We studied the adsorption characteristics of Na on propylene carbonate (PC), and the decomposition reaction of the Na–PC complex on a graphene sheet under PC solvent conditions, using first-principles calculations.
